notes: The Council tab was eating whatever you were typing. FOUR CAUSES, ALL MINE, ALL IN council.js. renderRooms() rebuilds croomWrap with innerHTML, and the room chat input was never captured across that rebuild. The Accord composer got captureDraft/restoreDraft in 1.3.8.0 and the chat box beside it did not, so every redraw threw away a half typed line. What triggered redraws: anyone posting in the room, an accord or seat moving (council_dirty), and a blind 30 second timer that called a FULL render whether or not anything had changed. With two people in a room that lands every few seconds, which is why it read as a 10 second refresh. FIXES. (1) The room input now preserves text, CARET and focus across every render, matching the composer; focus is only taken back if the person actually had it, so a redraw can no longer steal the cursor out of the composer or the main chat. (2) An incoming post APPENDS one line instead of rebuilding the pane, so the most frequent trigger no longer touches the input at all. (3) The 30 second tick, which exists only to age relative timestamps, skips entirely while anything in the pane has focus. (4) council_dirty defers and coalesces while typing rather than reloading mid sentence. Scroll position is kept too, and follows new messages down only if you were already at the bottom. Verified in a real DOM: 11 assertions, plus a control run against the unfixed code that reproduces the symptom exactly. CLIENT ONLY. No restart. Hard refresh required.
